comparison.objective: Beat an egg in a pan while stabilizing the pan and containing the contents; candidate adjusts a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel restraint, whisk grasping, repeated mixing contact, and spill avoidance versus precision key use, collar tuning, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Yolk and white must mix, only the whisk may touch the egg, and the flat pan must retain all contents; candidate uses stroke, impact, rebound, overload, and drift thresholds. Mixing uniformity and flatness thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Repeated mixing and containment differ materially from mechanical commissioning.
